goal: Allow libbitcoinkernel callers to serialize an entire witness stack in a single call
Eliminates quadratic overhead from reading witness items one by one
reviewability: Open for reviewer input on which witness retrieval API design is preferred
agreement: No reviewers have spoken in favor of the PR yet
Resolved objection: returning raw bytes requires consumers to parse consensus format (pzafonte)

categories.name: kernel
why: P3 because it offers a more efficient witness extraction method for libbitcoinkernel callers
Avoids quadratic extraction overhead but only benefits consumers needing full witness data
